# Dime Time

> Dime Time is a round-up debt payoff app. It links your bank accounts, rounds up everyday purchases to the nearest dollar, and applies that spare change toward paying down your debts — credit cards, student loans, and more.

Dime Time is available on the web at https://dime-time.com, on the Apple App Store, and on Google Play.

## How it works

- Connect your bank securely (via Plaid) so Dime Time can see everyday transactions.
- Each purchase is rounded up to the nearest dollar; the spare change accumulates.
- Round-ups are directed toward the debts you choose, helping you pay them down steadily.
- You can also import debts automatically from linked accounts and track payoff progress.
